title: Navy overcharging for parts

tellings.quote: there's a really interesting example of this back in the 80s and 90s of the Navy.

plain: In the 1980s and 1990s, the Navy was overcharged for parts, a case one guest uses to show how money can move through the Pentagon's budget unnoticed. A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb raises it on the show, without naming a source, as "a really interesting example" from that time, in an episode about how a hidden Pentagon UFO programme might be paid for. The point is that padded costs could, in principle, hide spending on secret work.
